mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_role_perm ( menu_no , role_no , disp_yn , view_yn , ins_yn , upd_yn , del_yn , reg_user , reg_date ) SELECT menu_no , #{roleNo} , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , #{regUser} , NOW() FROM menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_no AS menuNo , m.menu_name AS menuName , m.menu_lev AS menuLev , m.sort_ord AS sortOrd , p.disp_yn AS dispYn , p.view_yn AS viewYn , p.ins_yn AS insYn , p.upd_yn AS updYn , p.del_yn AS delYn FROM menu m LEFT JOIN menu_role_perm p ON m.menu_no = p.menu_no AND p.role_no = #{roleNo} WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.sort_ord ASC
